'''Jamesaphobia Sir, There's Too Many of Them!''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jamesaphobia]]
* '''Published:''' 30 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Death Star II: Docking Bay|DS2-D-deathstariidockingbay.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Death Star II: Docking Bay
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed Death Star II Docking Bay Jamesa.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A Reinactment of the Battle of Endor, the space part that is.  It's pretty fun to play, and it hasn't lost since it was made.  Please give me advice on what to do to make it better.

== Strategy ==

The strategy of this deck is to mainly beat down the opponents air with overwhelming amounts of Star Destroyers.  That's really about it.
